prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one transparent game character battle sprite for a pixel-art deckbuilding game. Cute roughly 2.5-head-tall proportions with a VERY LARGE clear head: face is 35-45 logical pixels tall, each eye at least 7 pixels across. Eyelids, brows, iris, nose and mouth must survive display at 128 x 160. One single character, complete feet and weapon, centered with 5% transparent padding, three-quarter front view facing slightly right, dynamic but calm battle-ready stance. Transparent background, no text, no labels, no ground, no shadow rectangle, no scenery. Character-specific face takes priority over a generic cute template.

Character-specific face and pose: Playful cat girl, HETEROCHROMIA: one ORANGE eye and one BLUE eye, bright round irises, cheerful lifted eyebrows and cute open smile. Preserve asymmetric iris colors.
Original appearance: Peach-orange hair, cat ears and red headband, oversized cream-yellow cardigan, white-red cat-themed dress.
Signature prop: Wear cream cat-paw mittens with visible pink paw pads.
Single face must remain readable at game size; honor the precise individual iris colors, eyelid shape, eyebrow angles and mouth expression above.
processing: Alpha-bound crop, nearest-neighbour resize, transparent padding.
